messages:
devon: Quick props to @sarah and @omar for pulling the emergency Dedicated rollback last night — saved a major demo. You two rock :trophy:
omar: thanks! we ended up patching the autoscaler rule, should be stable now. big shout to infra oncall @kim for the logs
sarah: team effort! also shoutout to @jules from SRE for the quick log parsing trick. :raised_hands:
kim: :coffee: i'll accept cookies as thanks (but really, nice work everyone)
jules: happy to help. grep I used was tiny but useful:
```bash
jq -r '.events[] | select(.level=="error")' /var/log/redwood/*.json | head -n 50
```
maria: Adding to this — product pulled a last-minute demo tweak and it landed smoothly. Extra props to @devon for coordinating across teams
ben: can we do a tiny IRL thank-you tomorrow? donuts in kitchen 10:30? :doughnut:
devon: yes please! i'll bring extra napkins :grin:
ops-bot: Reminder: kitchen booking confirmed 10:20-11:00 by #random — please keep it tidy
sarah: love the energy. thanks everyone :heart:
